facts.text: The mcp-fallback extension reads MCP manifests from `.pi/mcp.json`, then `.mcp.json`, resolved against the working directory, and drops entries with `enabled: false`. `MCPManager` is created with `closed` defaulting to true, and non-lazy manifests are discovered in `discoverMcp`.

The MCP adapter in `packages/tools/mcp` is closed by default. In closed mode stdio commands must be pinned paths, header and OAuth values come only from allowlisted environment variables, and manifests reference credentials by environment-variable name. Credential values are never shown in manifest listings.

`resolveToolEvidence` in `packages/tools/taskmanage/src/task-manage.ts` compares tool names case-sensitively. `tool:bash` is rejected when only `Bash` results exist, and the background Bash tool registers its name as `Bash` in `extensions/swarm-background-bash/extension.ts`.

TaskManage file evidence resolves against `workspaceRoot`, linked worktrees, and `evidenceRoots`, which are host-owned options that task input cannot set. Evidence outside these roots fails with reason `outside_allowed_roots`, and that message does not name the resolution root.

Tool evidence resolution tries the exact tool name first and uses an alias only when the alias maps to exactly one target. The alias is canonicalized when evidence is saved, and completion resolves evidence exactly, so later alias changes do not retarget saved evidence.

TaskManage completion returns `validation_failed` for duplicate or unknown answer question IDs and for any task question without an answer. Creating a task requires 1..MAX_TASK_QUESTIONS questions, so creation-time questions must be answered before completion succeeds.
